verdict.rationale: Docs explicitly describe provisioning a dedicated, isolated database per AI agent that you 'create, token-scope, and tear down via the API' (turso-docs-8), directly matching least-privilege per-agent credentials, and the MCP integration uses OAuth-based auth rather than shared static tokens (turso-docs-9/37, confirmed live via turso-probe-rt-3). Missing for 10: detailed documentation of fine-grained permission scopes (e.g., read-only vs write, table-level scopes) and independent/hands-on validation of the token-scoping API itself.
